title: Virtual Compute: the invoice correction basis
content:
## Retired clause 1

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “Correct an erroneous charge to the approved review pretax net amount plus tax amount, following the applicable tax treatment.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — For source subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values. Compare that corrected gross amount with the source original gross amount less cumulative correction credits plus cumulative debit adjustments; do not include service-credit concessions in this correction comparison. Credit the positive overcharge, debit the positive undercharge, and make no write when equal. A credit amount is negative and its net and tax components preserve the source proportions except an approved tax correction. An upward correction carries positive amount. Return the existing adjustment when the reviewed target has already been achieved. No cash refund is implicit in an invoice correction. Link original source reference to the original charge and related evidence reference to the approved review, never to a broad invoice containing several lines. Use the gross correction total from the exact-source correction and service-credit totals for the correction comparison; the pretax service-credit total never changes the approved corrected billing target.

## Evidence — approved correction

For credit, debit adjustment, For source subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, original source reference, related evidence reference, status, decision. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference, original source reference, related evidence reference.

## Recorded accounting basis

All posted credit and debit adjustment events through the frozen handling time for the exact original source reference. For the exact original charge original source reference, report the gross correction total as absolute correction credit amount less debit-adjustment amount, and the pretax service-credit total as absolute pretax pretax net amount of service-credit postings. Keep these two named components separate; tax is included only in the gross correction total, and unrelated source charges never enter either component.

superseded_clauses: Correct an erroneous charge to the approved review net_amount plus tax_amount, following evt_tax.
